title: Job Tracker
tech: React, Tailwind CSS, Firebase, Express js, Mongodb
description: Job Tracker is a productivity tool that allows users to manage and track their job applications in one place. Users can add, update, and delete jobs with different statuses like 'Pending', 'Interview', or 'Declined'. It helps job seekers stay organized and never miss an opportunity.
challenges: Managing complex state with Redux and integrating Firebase for authentication and real-time data updates was a challenge, especially with ensuring responsive UI on all devices.
future: Future plans include adding notification support, PDF export functionality, and integration with external job APIs to fetch new job listings.
